description: Halict turns a form into work you can finish. Describe the form you want in a sentence and Halict builds the questions, gives you a link to share, and starts collecting answers within a minute. Respondents see one question at a time, so long forms still get completed. Every response keeps its own owner and status, replies go out from the same screen, and opens are recorded, so nothing is lost between the submission and the answer. From ChatGPT you can create and publish forms, read the answers that came in, move a response to the next stage, and leave notes for your team.
